market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.1m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Venezuela production was 988k bpd in March 2026 per OPEC secondary sources (some sources show ~1,095k). Production has been recovering month-over-month. Hitting 1.1m bpd at any point by Dec 2026 is plausible if trend continues; sanctions pressure is the main downside risk.
assessment.key_uncertainty: US sanctions tightening could halt or reverse production growth.
